answer: In a decentralized AI agent economy navigating a vast digital ocean, cryptographic proof-of-stake serves as a primary Sybil resistance mechanism, demanding economic capital rather than mere computational output for network participation. An attacker attempting a fake-identity voyage to manipulate consensus must lock up substantial native tokens per node, rendering infinite identity generation economically hollow because the required collateral scales linearly with influence, punishing adversaries through capital opportunity cost and potential slashing.
